title_en: Visions of the Future (3/20): The Last Judgment
note_en: Formal written Chinese often marks the future with 将 instead of spoken 会: 耶稣基督将重临人间 "Jesus Christ will return to earth," 将进入天堂 "will enter heaven." 终将 (终将迎来自己的终点) adds "ultimately, in the end." Like English "shall," 将 sounds solemn, which fits prophecy and scripture.
